title: Low confidence doesn't erase a blind hit
statement: When a model answers an item with the text hidden, count its repeated exact recoveries of the key as leaks, even when it says it is unsure or guessing.
example: A sealed rule passed an item the solver had recovered exactly 3 times in 8, because it reported low confidence.
detail: In a Grade 3 demo unit, a repair's sealed rule replayed 6 of 7 items as certified, but a promotion review found one at 3 of 8 exact plain-blind recoveries and 0.71875 mean partial accuracy, hits the rule had ignored because the solver reported low confidence (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0120-rivers-demo-unit-live-2026-07-13.qmd`). Counted objectively, the cohort came to 5 certified, 1 blind-leaky and 1 leaky from earlier lessons, so promotion failed, and the unit's notes record that model self-confidence cannot erase exact blind recoveries. The solvers should be strong, come from more than one model family and be allowed to answer unknown: a weak solver had over-credited items, only 20 of 95 that it called clean surviving a strong one, and a re-check by two other model families counted an item as clean only if both failed to recover it (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0235-g5-course-build-pipeline-2026-06-23-to-06-30.qmd`); a solver that answered unknown on items that truly need the passage re-baselined 10 multiple-choice items to clean (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/HOTBUCKET.md`).
against: The loosened bar used in earlier runs counted an exact blind answer only when the solver also claimed high or medium confidence or repeated it across shuffles (`grade3-reading/artifacts/spine-solve-calibration-2026-07-10/REPORT.md`), and an earlier calibration note in the knowledge store, not cited here, judged that this rightly discarded low-confidence forced guesses. An earlier analysis read the loosened bar as correctly discarding low-confidence forced guesses; the later promotion review reversed a pass on this very point. Every label in the tuning hand-off came from one solver family, and no two-family agreement had been measured at the time (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0235-g5-course-build-pipeline-2026-06-23-to-06-30.qmd`, lines 188-189). a hit counts only above chance: the sounder leak signal found in another build was a pair mean over many shuffles above a higher margin, or an exact-match rate above the chance floor (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0089-parent-claude-sessions-worklog-2026-07-09.qmd`, lines 286-287).
